properties.statement: Wrote a throwaway Python script over the committed export to answer "which registered Artifact covers this file path?" — given the handful of files a change touched, return the artifact ids whose `location` matches, so I know which baselines to re-take. Needed it in three separate changes across two days: every time a set of files is edited, the next step is re-checksumming exactly the artifacts that cover them, and there is no way to ask which those are.
